title: Finalising the accounts of Bright Lamps
body: Kabir is the sole proprietor of 'Bright Lamps', a shop selling electrical fittings. While finalising the accounts for the year ended 31 March, his accountant made three decisions. First, a shop building bought four years ago for Rs 9 lakh was shown at Rs 22 lakh, its present market value. Second, the method of valuing closing stock was changed from the one used last year, which raised the stock value by about 12 per cent, and no note of the change was given. Third, a customer has filed a suit against the shop for supplying faulty wiring. Kabir's lawyer expects the court to rule in the customer's favour, but the exact amount of damages is not yet known. The accountant decided to ignore the expected damages because the amount is uncertain and the judgment is not yet out. The bank to which Kabir has applied for a loan is studying these statements.
